closure_repairs.summary: The toolbar action next to refresh now uses a visible New MMSChat label with a plus-bubble icon and copy that distinguishes launch preview from refresh.

Launch-plan metadata and preview failures caused by missing MMS methods render inline compatibility guidance in the sheet instead of a generic load-failed alert, while leaving the sheet closable and read-only.
Assistant transcript rendering now keeps fenced code blocks, adds ordered and unordered list blocks, and uses AttributedString(markdown:) for inline markdown where safe.
Mixed transcript messages now keep the parent bubble anchored to final text when present and add per-content chips so reasoning, tool, and final assistant sections remain visually separated.

feedback_mapping.title: Detail transcript content classification
feedback_mapping.summary: Detail rendering classifies transcript items by kind first and falls back to type, so user, assistant, reasoning, and tool content route to the intended UI. Mixed messages also show per-content role chips.

feedback_mapping.title: Tool cards and error surfacing
feedback_mapping.summary: Tool calls and results render as structured cards with name, command, cwd, input preview, and explicit error styling when isError is true.

feedback_mapping.title: Markdown transcript readability
feedback_mapping.summary: Transcript text supports headings, quotes, fenced code, paragraphs, ordered lists, unordered lists, and inline Markdown via AttributedString(markdown:) with text selection preserved.

feedback_mapping.title: Stable list grouping
feedback_mapping.summary: Session grouping stays deterministic by preserving insertion order within grouped sorted sessions and using stable tie-breakers for activity, creation time, and id.

feedback_mapping.title: Exact activity time display
feedback_mapping.summary: Row subtitle now shows time only for today, localized weekday plus time for the same week, and short date plus time for older sessions without adding new strings.

feedback_mapping.title: Launch toolbar clarity and localization
feedback_mapping.summary: The top action is now visibly New MMSChat with plus-bubble icon, localized label, and hint; it opens the launch preview sheet and no longer reads as a second refresh action.
